name: Glass Wing Gauze
source:
"I've never thought of myself as someone interesting or noteworthy, that's why I was surprised when a beautiful girl approached me at school and suddenly just confessed her love to me, despite never having met her before. I can't explain it, but being around her just makes me feel safe ... Protected. I wonder what can I learn about her and if it's somehow connected to this strange pink feathers I keep finding around, my research says they're an omen from the heavens but ... What could it all mean?"

[From [url=https://amahstudios.itch.io/glass-wing-gauze]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我从没觉得自己是个多么有趣或值得关注的人；正因如此，当学校里一位素昧平生的美少女突然走到我面前向我表白时，我才会惊讶得不知所措。我说不清是为什么，但待在她身边总能让我感到莫名的安心……仿佛受到了庇护。我很好奇自己能进一步了解到关于她的什么秘密，以及这一切是否与我在四周频频捡到的奇异粉色羽毛有所关联——据我查阅的资料所说，那是来自天界的预兆，可是……这一切究竟意味着什么呢？”

[摘自[url=https://amahstudios.itch.io/glass-wing-gauze]itch.io[/url]]
